paper.title: Online Boosting for Multilabel Ranking with Top-k Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Online multilabel ranking (MLR) boosting with top-k feedback
unmapped: Objective is minimizing cumulative (unweighted) rank loss of an online booster; guarantees are loss bounds in terms of weak-learner edges, not regret against a comparator (objective field set to closest available value; it is really a cumulative-loss objective)
Learner outputs a ranking (score vector) over m labels; feedback is relevance of only the top-k ranked labels (top-k feedback); the learner cannot compute its own loss
Booster aggregates N online weak learners that receive full (estimated) cost vectors
Number of labels m is known to the learner
settings.definition_quote: At each timestep $t=1, \cdots, T$, the relevant labels are $R_t \subseteq [m]$... An adversary chooses a labelled example $(x_t, R_t) \in \X \times 2^{[m]}$ ... and sends $x_t$ to the learner. ... the learner then produces an $m$-dimensional score vector $y_t$ ... In the top-$k$ feedback setting, however, it only observes whether $l$ is in $R_t$ for each label $l \in \Top^k(\sigma(y_t))$.

algorithms.name: Top-kBBM (Boost-By-Majority for ranking with top-k feedback)

symbols.Phi_N_0: surrogate potential Phi^N(0) at zero scores
symbols.z: maximum value of any pairwise loss f^{a,b}

conditions: weak learners satisfy Top-kWLC(gamma, delta, S, b)
loss pairwise decomposable with pairwise functions proper, uncrossable and convex (Assumptions 1-3)
bound on L(s^N_t,R_t) (unrandomized scores), probability at least 1-N*delta

source.label: bbm_bound
source.quote: For any $T, N$ satisfying $\delta \ll \frac{1}{N}$, and any decomposed function $f^{a,b}$ that satisfies Assumptions ..., the total loss incurred by \optimalAlgo~satisfies the following inequality with probability at least $1-N\delta$ $$\sum_{t=1}^T L(s^N_t, R_t) \leq \Phi^N_{R_t}(0)T + \Otilde(\frac{2m^2}{\rho}zN),$$ where $z$ is the maximum possible value that any $\f{a, b}$ can output, and $\Otilde$ suppresses dependence on $\log\frac{1}{\delta}$.

results.notes: Cumulative loss bound for a boosting algorithm, not regret; Õ applies only to second term. Õ hides log(1/delta).

symbols.gamma: edge of weak learners in the weak learning condition

conditions: weak learners satisfy Top-kWLC with edge gamma
unweighted hinge loss used as potential loss; bound on unweighted rank loss of randomized predictions
tuning: uniform randomization with exploration rate rho; paper suggests rho proportional to N*T^(-1/4)*sqrt(2)

source.label: opt_corollary
source.quote: For any $T$ and $N \ll \frac{1}{\delta}$, \optimalAlgo's randomized predictions $\ytilde_t$ satisfy the following bound on the rank loss with probability at least $1-N\delta$ \sum_{t=1}^T \Rank_t(\ytilde_t) \leq \frac{m^2}{4}(N+1)\exp(-\frac{\gamma^2N}{2})T + \rho m^2 T + \Otilde(\frac{2m^2}{\rho}N^2\sqrt{T}).

results.notes: Cumulative rank loss (not regret). Appendix states without formal theorem a single-swap variant: m^2/4(N+1)exp(-gamma^2N/2)T + 2 rho m T + Õ((2m^2-k^2)/rho N^2 sqrt(T)) (requires k>=3, rho<0.25).

symbols.gamma_sum: sum over weak learners of absolute empirical edges sum_i |gamma_i|

conditions: bound on cumulative unweighted rank loss of randomized predictions
tuning: SGD step eta_t = 8*rho*sqrt(2)/(m^2*sqrt(t)) on alpha in [-2,2]
paper suggests rho proportional to sqrt(2N/sum_i|gamma_i|) T^(-1/4)

source.label: ada_bound
source.quote: For any $T, N$ satisfying $\delta \ll \frac{1}{N}$, the cumulative rank loss of \adaptiveAlgo, $\sum_{t=1}^{T}\Rank(\ytilde_t, R_t)$, satisfies the following bound with probability at least $1-(N+4)\delta$: $$ \frac{2m^2}{\sum_i|\gamma_i|}T +\rho m^2T + \Otilde(\frac{2m^2 N\sqrt{T}}{\rho\sum_i|\gamma_i|}),$$ where $\Otilde$ suppresses dependence on $\log\frac{1}{\delta}$.

results.notes: Proof actually gives 2 m^2 log2 constant in first term. Empirical edges are data-dependent. Appendix single-swap variant (informal): 2m^2 log2/sum|gamma_i| T + 2 rho m T + Õ((2m^2-k^2)N sqrt(T)/(rho sum|gamma_i|)).
